Machan — Taj Mansingh, New Delhi (2018).

The Taj’s all-day diner, named for the hunter’s treehouse — an art programme for a room set in 1933, at the height of the colonial Raj. A tiger painted into the foliage; copper raised in relief on a verdigris plinth; architectural plates farmed from across the colonies; binoculars and telescopes shadow-boxed into green pillars. Mahogany, brass, old-world charm.

Artwork & installation — Anirudh Kapoor. A·03
